name: skill-safety-guard
description: Security guard before installing third-party Skills/MCPs. One command scans for credential leaks, dangerous shell, native file deletion (Rust/Python/Go/PS), OWASP patterns, multi-framework configs (Windsurf/Copilot/Docker/K8s), CI/CD security, and checks your Pi Agent global security — 246 rules, 13 categories, open-source rule library. Scan before you trust.
author: Wahero
